sample_unit: patients (federated training cohort; a further 32,986 patients in evaluation)

links.outcome: Change in AUROC from local site-specific fine-tuning of the global model
links.effect: Site-specific tuning of the global model did not significantly improve performance (change in AUROC <0.01) at OUH and PUH.
links.quote: Site-specific tuning of the global model did not significantly improve performance (change in AUROC <0·01).

unlisted_practices: Federated learning across hospitals to train models without centralising patient data
Low-cost embedded microcomputing (Raspberry Pi) for privacy-preserving multisite model training and evaluation
Multicentre training to reduce bias and improve generalisability

screen.reason: The study tests an operational deployment architecture (plug-and-play microcomputing federated learning pipeline) across multiple NHS hospital groups, evaluating how federated multi-site training and local fine-tuning compare to local-only model training in multi-center healthcare environments.

primary.practice: federated learning vs local model training and fine-tuning
